data.name: Aquib
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Aqibah' meaning 'young lion' or 'descendant'. This name is mentioned in the Quran as a title given to Prophet Yunus (Jonah) when he was thrown into the sea and swallowed by a whale. It symbolizes the strength, courage, and resilience of a young lion in the face of adversity.

Despite being in the belly of a whale for several days, he never lost faith in Allah and continued to implore Him for forgiveness and mercy. When he was finally released, he repented and returned to his people with a message of forgiveness and mercy. The name Aquib, as a title given to Prophet Yunus, represents the strength and resilience of a person of faith, who remains steadfast in their belief and trust in Allah even in the face of adversity. It serves as a reminder of the importance of faith, perseverance, and forgiveness in our spiritual journey.
